The '''Outbreak Response blaster rifle''' was a model of [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] used by [[the Hyland Organization for Rakghoul Neutralization]] during the [[Rakghoul pandemic]], during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TOR:RR" />

Outbreak Response blaster rifles were later used by [[Hidden Chain]] commanders of [[Clan Ha'rangir]] on [[Ruhnuk]].<ref name="TOR:SoR">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=other||Ruhnuk}}</ref>
